question.text: Option sellers benefit from which Greek?

explanation.text: The Logic: Option prices lose time value as expiry approaches, giving option sellers a fundamental advantage from price decline over the option's life. A short option position has positive theta, so theta is "friendly" to the option seller. The Trap: Theta benefits the seller specifically through time decay; it is not a directional or volatility-based gain. Note: Pages 72 and 74-75 of the NISM Series-I workbook support time decay of option prices, the seller's advantage from price decline over option life, the positive theta of a short option, and theta being friendly to the seller.
